Container.Name: ToastTV Other
Container.Overview: Headless ToastTV server with collection-first TV and movie libraries, fail-closed Kids 7 ratings policy, parent review, metadata-driven station automation, deterministic channels, and an LG webOS client.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: kids television channels schedule family media
Container.Requires: Readable local TV and Movies directories on the Unraid host. Keep the Web UI on a trusted LAN because authentication is not implemented yet.
Container.Changes: 0.7.2 stores TMDB episode metadata, cleans schedule labels, fixes channel-card overflow, and keeps animation out of nature-documentary programming.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the ToastTV administration UI and API.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database, thumbnails, transcode cache, and parent overrides. Stop the container before copying raw SQLite files for backup.

Config.Name: TV Shows
Config.Description: Read-only TV library. Shows are grouped by folder, enriched by TMDB, and remain review-only unless policy or a parent allows them.

Config.Name: Movies
Config.Description: Read-only movie library. Movies are grouped by folder and unknown or unrated titles never auto-approve.

Config.Name: Interludes
Config.Description: Optional read-only station idents, bumpers, and interludes.

Config.Name: Container Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone for logs and legacy date handling. Each channel's schedule timezone is configured in the persistent library policy.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key (Bootstrap)
Config.Description: Optional first-start fallback. Prefer ToastTV Settings > Metadata; saved appdata settings override this value.

Config.Name: Rating Region (Bootstrap)
Config.Description: Optional first-start ISO country-code fallback. Configure the live value in ToastTV Settings > Metadata.

Config.Name: Rating Fallback Regions (Bootstrap)
Config.Description: Optional first-start comma-separated fallback country codes. Configure the live order in ToastTV Settings > Metadata.

Config.Name: TMDB Language (Bootstrap)
Config.Description: Optional first-start metadata-language fallback. Configure the live value in ToastTV Settings > Metadata.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user ID used for persistent appdata files.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Unraid users group ID used for persistent appdata files.

Config.Name: TV Root
Config.Description: Managed TV root inside the container.

Config.Name: Movie Root
Config.Description: Managed movie root inside the container.

Config.Name: Library Policy
Config.Description: Persistent fail-closed Kids 7 rating, programming-group, channel-slot, and channel-timezone policy. Seeded into appdata on first start.

Config.Name: Headless Server
Config.Description: Disables MPV, HDMI-CEC, and Raspberry Pi playback hardware.

Config.Name: Read-only Media
Config.Description: Disables upload and media deletion operations.

Config.Name: In-container Updates
Config.Description: Container images are updated by Unraid rather than the legacy bare-metal updater.
